notes.title: New PLAYISM Title: Giraffe and Annika Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear PLAYISM fans,

We are writing to inform you that today marks the release of our newest title.

Heartfelt 3D Action+Rhythm Action game, Giraffe and Annika.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1122100/Giraffe__Annika/

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r2PcSX7iinw

Set on Spica Island, enjoy the sights and sounds as you embark on a journey packed with 3D platforming action, adventure, and rhythm game boss fights!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/ea5cafad264aac0053fa8150484c26945a023871.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/311fa9b4c2a07e69510dbd7835c3e014fd0335a9.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/44215ecb8f1da94cfd33ee8e8323561db2b65a6f.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/a155b8b4391c3107f29bbf4588b444a20f1eabeb.jpg[/img]

Soundtrack also available!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1241210/Giraffe_and_Annika_Original_Sound_Track/

notes.title: Update 06/28 - Crash Fix!
notes.notes:
Thank you for the cooperation everyone! We have been working really hard on figuring out how to resolve the problem with Healer crashing. 

We have resolved the following:
[list][*]Fixed the crash bug which occurs around 11% when loading for the PC system language is set to French or other languages.[/list]

We hope that you keep enjoying A Healer Only Lives Twice!

notes.title: Update - 06/27
notes.notes:
Hi all

We have updated A Healer Only Lives Twice. 
If you get an error message during loading the game, please contact us with the contents of the error message. This will help us identify the problem you are currently facing. 

We have updated with the following: 
[list][*]Loading speed improved upon start-up.
[*]Memory usage is lowered during the loading.
[*]Loading percentage now has a decimal point.[/list]


We hope you keep enjoying A Healer Only Lives Twice

notes.title: A Healer Only Lives Twice Update - 6/23
notes.notes:
We have been collecting reports and information from users for a while now and worked relentlessly on locating the problem of the game crashing upon startup. 
We have now updated the game in order to fix this problem. 

We believe that this should take care of all the problems, if not please let us know in the forums!! 
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/453300/discussions/0/350532795336374502/]Main Bug Reports Thread[/url]

We will be always be collecting bug reports and working together with you!

[h1]We hope you keep enjoying A Healer Only Lives Twice![/h1]

notes.title: 2016/6/13 Update
notes.notes:
[h1][Bug fix][/h1]
[list][*]Minimized the size of an icon for "Volume mixer"
[*]Fix the crash when moving the focus to the Desktop when playing in full-screen
[*]Fix the issue that skill's rank limit gets unlocked when playing MAIN EX mode.
[/list]
[h1][Other fix][/h1]
[list][*]Now the the game prompts the error when DirectInput initialization fails.
* This game requires DirectInput, but since some Windows doesn't have them as default, please download it from Microsoft page (Steam version will install it automatically)
DirectX End-User Runtimes
https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=19743
[*]Now the game won't accepts the keyboard input when the game is not focused.
This will prevent the game reacting the input when the user using web browser or anything.
[*]The sound balancing is fixed.[/list]
